name: Steel Cut Oats
siboNotes: Steel cut oats are well-tolerated and provide beneficial soluble fiber that can help regulate gut bacteria without feeding SIBO overgrowth.
preparationTips: Soak overnight to reduce cooking time and improve digestibility
Cook with low-FODMAP milk alternatives like lactose-free milk or almond milk
Add low-FODMAP toppings like blueberries, strawberries, or maple syrup
Store cooked oats in refrigerator for up to 5 days for meal prep
